We’re building something special for the hotel industry, and we’re looking for a Director of Marketing who feels at home in the world of hotel technology.


If you’ve spent meaningful time marketing to hoteliers, understand how hotel decision-makers think, and enjoy rolling up your sleeves to create campaigns that drive pipeline, you’ll thrive in this role.


This is a hands-on, full-funnel leadership role responsible for building and scaling our marketing engine. You will oversee demand generation, product marketing, content creation, and go-to-market strategy while working closely with Sales to drive qualified leads and revenue growth.


The hospitality industry values clarity, trust, and solutions that make operations easier. We’re looking for someone who knows how to communicate exactly that.


What You’ll Be Doing

Develop a deep understanding of the hotel ecosystem, including independent hotels, management companies, and brand-affiliated properties.


Stay closely connected to the needs and priorities of hotel decision-makers such as:

  • General Managers
  • Directors of Sales and Marketing
  • Revenue Managers
  • Digital marketing leaders
  • IT leaders


Use these insights to shape messaging, positioning, and campaigns that resonate with hotel operators.


Owning the Marketing Engine

Build and manage the full marketing funnel—from awareness through lead generation, nurturing, and conversion to sales.


Key areas include:

  • Demand generation strategy
  • SEO and digital acquisition
  • Email and lifecycle marketing
  • Webinars and industry events
  • Campaign development and execution


Your goal is to ensure marketing consistently generates qualified pipeline for the sales team.


Leading Blog and Thought Leadership Strategy

Own and grow the company’s blog and thought leadership presence to establish authority in the hospitality technology space and drive inbound demand.


This includes:

  • Writing and overseeing blog content focused on hotel industry trends and insights
  • Creating thought leadership around topics like AI in hospitality, guest engagement, and direct booking strategies
  • Developing SEO-driven blog content that attracts hotel decision-makers researching solutions
  • Implement AI Engine Optimization (AEO) strategies to ensure the company and its content are discoverable through AI agents like Copilot, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and other emerging AI-driven discovery platforms.
  • Repurposing blog content into campaigns, LinkedIn posts, webinars, and sales materials


Creating Content That Speaks the Hotel Industry’s Language

Develop and oversee content that resonates with hospitality leaders, including:

  • Blog articles and thought leadership pieces
  • Industry guides and educational resources
  • Case studies and ROI stories
  • Campaign messaging and landing pages
  • Sales enablement materials


The goal is content that feels authentic, practical, and directly relevant to hotel operators , while positioning the company as a trusted voice in hospitality technology.


Becoming Deeply Fluent in the Product

You will develop strong product knowledge and become fluent in how the platform works.


This includes understanding:

  • How the product integrates into the hotel technology stack
  • The operational problems it solves for hotel teams
  • The value it creates for revenue growth and guest engagement


This fluency will help shape messaging, positioning, and product launches.


Partnering Closely with Sales

Marketing and sales alignment is critical in this role.


You will work closely with the sales team to:

  • Align on pipeline and growth targets
  • Develop campaigns that generate qualified opportunities
  • Support sales with content, messaging, and materials
  • Continuously improve lead quality and funnel performance


Using Data to Drive Decisions

Track performance across the funnel and continuously improve marketing efficiency.


You will analyze:

  • Lead generation performance
  • Campaign ROI
  • Funnel conversion metrics
  • Customer acquisition trends


Marketing should be measurable, predictable, and scalable.


Success in This Role

Success in this role will be measured by the ability to build a scalable marketing engine that consistently generates qualified pipeline.


Key outcomes include:

  • Growth in marketing-sourced and marketing-influenced pipeline
  • Consistent generation of qualified leads for the sales team
  • Increased inbound demand through SEO, blog content, and thought leadership
  • Strong campaign performance across webinars, events, and digital channels
  • Clear and compelling positioning that resonates with hotel decision-makers


What We’re Looking For

  • Experience marketing to hotels or within the hospitality technology ecosystem
  • Experience in B2B SaaS marketing and demand generation
  • Proven ability to generate qualified pipeline and measurable revenue impact
  • Strong writing and storytelling skills, including blogs and thought leadership content
  • Ability to translate complex technology into clear, compelling messaging
  • Comfort operating both strategically and hands-on
  • Experience collaborating closely with sales teams in a pipeline-driven environment
  • Interest in AI-driven platforms, automation, and emerging technology transforming hospitality


Experience at or working with hospitality technology platforms such as hotel CRM, guest engagement, marketing automation, revenue management, or hotel operations platforms is highly valued.


Why You Might Love This Role

You enjoy understanding how an industry works and building marketing that speaks directly to it.


You like owning the entire marketing engine , not just one channel.


You enjoy turning insight, content, and campaigns into measurable growth.


You want to help shape how the hospitality industry adopts the next generation of technology.


Why Join Us

You’ll be joining a modern AI-native product company that is helping reshape how hotels understand their guests, grow direct bookings, and operate more intelligently.


This is a rare opportunity to help introduce AI-powered guest engagement and marketing technology to the hospitality industry while building a marketing engine that drives real growth.


Your work will directly influence:

  • How the industry understands our product
  • How we position ourselves in the market
  • How we generate scalable demand


You won’t just run campaigns—you’ll help define how a new category of hospitality technology is introduced to the market and adopted by hotel leaders around the world.


If you’re energized by hospitality, great products, and building a marketing engine that truly moves the needle, we’d love to meet you.

title: Senior Data Engineer (Node.js / TypeScript)
description:
Job Title: Senior Data Engineer (Node.js / TypeScript)

Location: Remote – Brazil


Job Description

We are seeking a Senior Data Engineer with strong Node.js and TypeScript expertise to build scalable backend systems and data services. The ideal candidate will have recent hands-on experience with Node.js , strong database expertise in MongoDB and SQL , and experience building high-performance APIs .


This role focuses on designing and developing scalable backend services that support high-volume data processing and integration across digital platforms. Experience with GraphQL is preferred but not mandatory.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services using Node.js and TypeScript .
  • Build and optimize REST/GraphQL APIs for high-performance data access and integration.
  • Develop and maintain data models and database schemas across MongoDB and SQL databases .
  • Implement scalable data ingestion and processing pipelines .
  • Work with distributed systems in a cloud-based environment .
  • Ensure performance optimization, reliability, and scalability of backend services.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product, architecture, and engineering.
  • Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies such as sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives.
  • Follow DevOps best practices , including CI/CD, testing, and monitoring.


Required Skills

  • 5+ years of experience in backend engineering or data engineering .
  • Strong recent hands-on experience with Node.js .
  • Proficiency in TypeScript and JavaScript .
  • Strong experience with MongoDB and SQL databases .
  • Experience building REST APIs or GraphQL APIs .
  • Solid understanding of data modeling and database design .
  • Experience working in cloud environments (AWS preferred) .
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, testing frameworks, and modern development practices .


Nice to Have

  • Experience with GraphQL architecture or schema design .
  • Experience with distributed systems and high transaction platforms .
  • Knowledge of ETL pipelines and data processing frameworks .
  • Experience working in digital media, sports, or high-scale consumer platforms .


Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field , or equivalent practical experience.

title: Coordenador de Banco de Dados
description:
Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:

Esta pessoa terá como objetivo atuar de forma alinhada à visão estratégica de Negócios do Grupo Fleury, contribuindo para a construção de um ecossistema de Saúde integrado, preventivo e híbrido, tendo como principal foco o cuidado com as pessoas.

Se você tem interesse em fazer parte desse propósito e deseja estar sempre um passo a frente do mercado, vem com a gente!


Sobre a área:

  • Lidar com diversos fornecedores de produtos e serviços que atendem a disciplina de Banco de Dados acompanhando, gerindo e cobrando ações quando necessário.
  • Interagir com as áreas pares para entender e endereçar demandas, novos projetos, problemas, duvidas e reclamações a respeito do ambiente de Bando de Dados.
  • Cuidar para que o ambiente se mantenha atualizado e com as ultimas features de segurança.
  • Assegurar o uso otimizado dos recursos tecnológicos da plataforma através da análise das métricas de capacidade dos bancos de dados;
  • Planejar, elaborar e executar projetos de infraestrutura de Banco de Dados liderando equipes heterogêneas afim de otimizar e maximizar a performance de cada indivíduo além de atender as novas demandas das áreas de negócio;
  • Implantar recursos de bancos de dados para capacitar o ambiente a suportar crescimentos e demandas de negócio mesmo que ainda não mapeadas;
  • Apoiar, instruir e direcionar o time técnico afim de sanar dúvidas, questões técnicas ou processuais a respeito da disciplina de Banco de Dados;
  • Cumprir as metas estabelecidas no Contrato de Gestão e vigente, através da execução das ações previstas no plano de metas;


Principais atividades:

  • Supervisionar e acompanhar a disciplina de Banco de Dados, participando de projetos e crises, contribuindo e orientando os seus liderados na forma de atuar e ser um facilitador nas interfaces com as outras disciplinas tanto de Operações, Engenharia de Infraestrutura e Engenharia de Desenvolvimento.
  • Acompanhar, validar e medir a qualidade e saúde do ambiente de Banco de Dados.
  • Estruturar e acompanhar os indicadores da area de Banco de Dados .
  • Tracionar iniciativas de automação para a gestão do ambiente de Banco de Dados, reduzindo atividades operacionais e garantindo agilidade e tempo de resposta as mudanças de ambiente.
  • Contribuir para obter um clima organizacional favorável, bem como a redução do turn over, através de ferramentas de gestão de pessoas, como contratações assertivas, comunicação interna eficaz, treinamento e desenvolvimento, reconhecimento e recompensa, buscando equipes de alta performance.
  • Zelar pelo sigilo das informações tratadas na sua área de atuação.
  • Cumprir as metas estabelecidas no Contrato de Gestão vigente, através da execução das ações previstas no plano de metas. Liderar um time de Banco de Dados com diversas stacks de Banco de Dados tanto onpremises quanto em Cloud.



Buscamos alguém que apresente:

  • Experiencia em gestão de pessoas
  • Habilidade de construir matriz de decisão, RFPs e RFIs
  • Experiencia de gestão financeira e de contratos de infraestrutura de TI
  • Conhecimento Avançado de banco de dados SQL Server
  • Conhecimento de Bancos Nativos Cloud
  • Conhecimento de banco de dados My SQL (Desejável)
  • Conhecimento de banco de dados No SQL (Desejável)
  • Cursos e certificações correlatas a Banco de dados


Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito.


Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que:


• Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times;

• Estejam em constante movimento, investindo em autodesenvolvimento e atuando como facilitadora no desenvolvimento das outras pessoas;

• Busquem consciência social de diversidade e inclusão, cooperando com a construção de um ambiente colaborativo;

• Identifiquem e antecipem as necessidades dos clientes, agindo prontamente para encontrar soluções adequadas e personalizadas;

• Planejem e executem o trabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade;

• Gerem e implementem novas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado.


Informações da vaga:

Modelo de Trabalho (Home Office)

Carga Horária: 220h

Escala: Segunda a Sexta

Horário de Trabalho: 08h00 ás 17h48


Cuidamos de você em cada etapa da sua jornada!


Saúde e Bem-estar:

• Assistência médica e odontológica para você e sua família;

• Ambulatório com clínica médica ou atendimento por telemedicina;

• Linhas de cuidado especializadas: gestantes, adoção, obesidade, oncologia, entre outras;

• Acesso à plataforma OrienteMe para sessões de terapia e orientação nutricional;

• Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas;

• Acesso ao Wellhub para práticas esportivas e qualidade de vida.


Proteção e estabilidade:

• Previdência privada;

• Participação nos lucros;

• Seguro de vida.


Facilidades para o dia a dia:

• Vale-Alimentação;

• Vale-Refeição;

• Vale-Transporte;

• Auxílio-Creche;

• Clube de Descontos com lojas, farmácias, viagem, beleza, cultura, lazer, entre outros serviços.


Desenvolvimento e educação:

• Plataforma de ensino;

• Parcerias educacionais com descontos em cursos e instituições.


Aqui, o cuidado vai além dos benefícios — ele está presente em cada momento da sua trajetória.


Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, focada na equidade e na valorização das diferenças. Nossas vagas são abertas para todos os públicos e, simbolizando a nossa intencionalidade, oferecemos oportunidades afirmativas.


Nosso compromisso vai além do cumprimento das legislações que incentivam a diversidade e inclusão. Trabalhamos ativamente para ampliar a representatividade de nossas pessoas, pensando em raça, etnia, gênero, gerações, pessoas com deficiência e LGBTQIAPN+ em nosso time, além de fortalecer a representatividade de mulheres negras, indígenas, chefes de família.


Para conhecer mais sobre o Grupo Fleury, acesse o site:

title: Business Development Manager
description:
Você é apaixonado pelo mundo dos pagamentos e quer liderar a expansão comercial da próxima geração de infraestrutura fintech no maior mercado da América Latina?


Na Akua estamos construindo a infraestrutura de pagamentos do futuro para a região: cloud-native, API-first e com inteligência artificial integrada. Nossa missão é ajudar bancos, fintechs, credenciadoras e grandes comerciantes a conectar múltiplos rails de pagamento, automatizar conciliações e simplificar sua infraestrutura financeira.


Estamos buscando a pessoa que vai liderar nosso crescimento comercial no Brasil : alguém que entenda profundamente o ecossistema de adquirência e meios de pagamento locais , fale a língua dos bancos, fintechs e credenciadoras, e tenha energia e visão para construir do zero.


O que buscamos?


Um/a Business Development Manager com sólida experiência no ecossistema de pagamentos brasileiro — especialmente em adquirência e meios de pagamento — e uma rede de contatos estabelecida em bancos, fintechs e credenciadoras/subadquirentes.


Você será o primeiro ponto de contato comercial da Akua no Brasil, responsável por gerar e fechar oportunidades estratégicas, com projeção clara de montar e liderar o time comercial do país à medida que escalamos.

title: Senior Fullstack Developer (Python + React)
description:
About The Company

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


About The Opportunity

We're seeking an experienced Senior Full Stack Developer to join our Supply Chain & Operations technology team. This is a high-impact role focused on rapid application development for business-critical systems that power clients' global supply chain, logistics, and operational excellence.

You'll work embedded within a dynamic, hybrid team of internal engineers and external collaborators, collaborating closely with business stakeholders, UX designers, and technical leads to deliver full-stack solutions that solve real operational challenges. This role requires someone who goes beyond just writing code; you'll need to understand user needs, contribute to requirements analysis, and bring strong product thinking to ensure we're building the right solutions.


Responsibilities

  • Design and develop full-stack web applications using React/TypeScript and JavaScript (frontend) and Python/FastAPI (backend) to address operational challenges in supply chain, logistics, and planning systems.
  • Build and optimize solutions for large-scale relational datasets with MySQL or PostgreSQL, ensuring query performance and data integrity.
  • Deploy and maintain containerized applications on Kubernetes, implementing infrastructure updates, connectivity enhancements, and cloud platform improvements.
  • Integrate with third-party systems, external APIs, workflow platforms, and enterprise services (IAM, authentication, etc.) while upholding security and privacy standards.
  • Apply DevSecOps practices throughout the development lifecycle, focusing on security by design, automated testing, and quality gates.
  • Support and maintain production systems, including triaging and resolving bugs, implementing enhancements, and executing planned infrastructure upgrades.


Required Qualifications

  • Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal)
  • Proven capabilities in backend development, focusing on Python with FastAPI in the backend , including RESTful API design and asynchronous programming patterns
  • Advanced proficiency in React and TypeScript for modern frontend development, Single Page Applications (SPA), including state management, performance optimization, and accessible UI design
  • Expertise in Vue.js, PHP/Symfony, and databases (MySQL or PostgreSQL).
  • Disciplined approach to code quality and testing (unit, integration, end-to-end) with experience in Git


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Data Analyst V
description:
Título da posição: Data Analyst V BRL

Tipo de contratação: Temporário via agência

Modelo de trabalho: Home office


Visão Geral da Posição

A equipe de Analytics de BMP (Business Model and Pricing) está em busca de um(a) Analista de Dados experiente para apoiar a gestão de performance do negócio e a tomada de decisões estratégicas por meio de análises avançadas. A equipe atua em parceria próxima com liderança, finanças, operações e stakeholders de negócio para mensurar o desempenho das nossas ofertas aos clientes, gerar insights sobre o comportamento dos clientes e impulsionar ações orientadas por dados em toda a organização.


O(a) Analista de Dados desempenhará um papel crítico na transformação de dados complexos em insights acionáveis, no desenvolvimento de frameworks analíticos e na viabilização do monitoramento de performance por meio de dashboards, relatórios e análises aprofundadas. Esta função exige forte rigor analítico, visão de negócio e capacidade de comunicar insights de forma clara para stakeholders seniores.


O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui histórico comprovado de entrega de análises de alto impacto em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais, além de estar confortável equilibrando análises estruturadas e recorrentes com demandas ad hoc que apoiam prioridades de negócio em constante evolução.


O que você fará

  • Aplicar forte mentalidade analítica e de resolução de problemas para identificar questões de negócio, lacunas de performance e oportunidades de melhoria, traduzindo-as em abordagens analíticas claras.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de BMP fornecendo insights sobre performance do negócio, eficiência operacional, direcionadores financeiros e KPIs estratégicos.
  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e modelos analíticos para acompanhar a performance em relação às metas e apoiar a tomada de decisão da liderança.
  • Conduzir análises ad hoc e aprofundadas para explicar tendências, variações, riscos e oportunidades, além de avaliar o impacto de iniciativas de negócio.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com stakeholders para entender objetivos, definir métricas relevantes e garantir que as entregas analíticas estejam alinhadas às necessidades de decisão.
  • Atuar em parceria com as equipes de engenharia de dados, finanças e outros times de analytics para garantir qualidade, consistência e escalabilidade das soluções de reporte.
  • Sintetizar análises complexas em narrativas claras e objetivas, apresentando resultados que traduzam dados em insights acionáveis para a liderança sênior.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua de frameworks analíticos, ferramentas e melhores práticas dentro da equipe de BMP Analytics.


Qualificações Mínimas

  • Mestrado em Analytics, Ciência de Dados, Economia, Estatística, Engenharia, Administração ou área quantitativa relacionada.
  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em análise de dados, analytics de negócio ou gestão de performance.
  • Experiência sólida com SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação analítica (Python ou equivalente).
  • Experiência na construção de dashboards e relatórios utilizando ferramentas de BI (preferencialmente Power BI).
  • Forte pensamento analítico, com capacidade comprovada de estruturar problemas ambíguos.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e apresentação, com capacidade de engajar públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Capacidade comprovada de colaboração eficaz em equipes multifuncionais.
  • Inglês fluente.


Qualificações Desejáveis

  • Experiência com análises financeiras ou de gestão de performance de negócios.
  • Familiaridade com técnicas analíticas avançadas (previsão, análise estatística, modelagem de cenários).
  • Experiência com ambientes de dados em nuvem (ex.: AWS).
  • Experiência com pipelines de dados, automação ou ferramentas de orquestração (ex.: Airflow).
  • Experiência com big data ou frameworks de processamento distribuído (ex.: Spark / PySpark).
  • Experiência em organização global matricial.

title: Engenheiro de Vendas
description:
Olá, nós somos a CDHORIZON BRAZIL.

A Horizon Construction Development Limited (“CDHORIZON”) é uma empresa líder em aluguel de equipamentos na China, comprometida em fornecer soluções completas em um único ponto de “producto + serviço” para seus clientes nos setores de construção e industrial.


Fundada em 2011 na China, ocupando o 11 lugar no ranking IRN 100, a CDHORIZON possue mais de 560 redes na China e no exterior, atendendo acumulativamente mais de 360.000 clientes no mercado chinês e internacional.


Em 2023, a CDHORIZON foi listada na Bolsa Principal de Hong Kong (SEHK), com o código de ação 09930.HK. A empresa realiza investimentos contínuos em Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento (P&D) e inovação. Nos últimos anos, a empresa expandiu-se stivamente para mercados internacionis e atualmente opera os negócios no Vietnã,Hong Kong, Malásia, Tailândia, Indonésia, Arábia Saudita, Turquia e Emirados Árabes Unidos, e agora Brazil!


Engenheiro de Vendas de Equipamentos construção civil e industriais


(Mandarim é necessario)

(Local de Trabalho: São Paulo, Brasil)

(Viagens de negócios iniciais a Xangai por 3 a 6 meses, seguidas de residência permanente trabalho no Brasil.)


Responsabilidades:

1. Responsável pelas vendas de máquinas e equipamentos industriais no mercado brasileiro.

2. Desenvolver e manter uma carteira de clientes no Brasil.

3. Conduzir negociações comerciais, assinatura de contratos e acompanhamento de recebimento de pagamentos.

4. Coletar e analisar informações sobre a concorrência em mercados internacionais.


Requisitos:

Antes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa: aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média.

A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados.

E se errarmos? Voltamos e consertamos rápido, até criarmos aquilo que acreditamos ser parte da transformação de cada cliente.

title: Digital Ad Designer
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle—from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

As a Digital Ad Designer at Lilo Social, you will create scroll-stopping static graphics for Meta advertising campaigns while designing high-converting landing pages that drive measurable results for DTC brands. You will collaborate closely with creative strategists and media buyers to translate performance insights into compelling visual creative that captures attention and converts browsers into buyers.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent improvement in creative performance metrics (CTR, conversion rate, thumb-stop rate) across your client portfolio
  • Fast iteration speed that enables creative variations per week with maintained quality standards
  • High client satisfaction through on-brand designs that align with strategic creative direction
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration that accelerates testing velocity and produces scalable winning concepts


Responsibilities

  • Design high-performing static graphics for Meta ad campaigns across feed, stories, and reels formats
  • Create conversion-focused landing pages that align with ad messaging and drive customer action
  • Execute on creative briefs provided by strategists, translating concepts into visually compelling designs
  • Iterate quickly based on performance data, A/B test results, and stakeholder feedback
  • Maintain brand consistency and visual standards across multiple client accounts simultaneously
  • Design mobile-first experiences optimized for Meta's platform specifications and best practices
  • Organize and manage design files, asset libraries, and version control using established naming conventions
  • Collaborate with media buyers to understand campaign objectives and creative testing priorities
  • Stay current on Meta platform trends, ad formats, and direct response design principles
  • Produce landing page designs that integrate seamlessly with existing brand systems and conversion frameworks
  • Participate in creative reviews and provide design rationale grounded in performance marketing principles
  • Adapt existing creative concepts into new formats, sizes, and placements efficiently


Requirements

  • 3-4 years of design experience in performance marketing, advertising, or DTC ecommerce
  • Expert proficiency in Figma for design collaboration and file organization
  • Strong command of Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop and Illustrator)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response creative and performance-focused design work
  • Proven experience designing ads specifically for Meta (Facebook and Instagram)
  • Understanding of mobile-first design principles and responsive layout techniques
  • Demonstrated ability to iterate quickly while maintaining high quality standards
  • Experience designing landing pages with conversion rate optimization in mind
  • Organized approach to file management with attention to naming conventions and version control
  • Comfort working with performance feedback and data-driven design decisions
  • Strong communication skills and ability to articulate design decisions
  • Self-starter mentality with ability to manage multiple client accounts and deadlines


Nice to Have

  • Motion graphics or animation skills with proficiency in After Effects or similar tools
  • Experience with landing page builders (Unbounce, Instapage, Replo, Shogun)
  • HTML/CSS knowledge for basic landing page customization
  • Understanding of Meta Ads Manager and campaign performance metrics
  • Experience working in an agency environment with multiple simultaneous client accounts
  • Familiarity with Shopify and ecommerce product page design
  • Knowledge of direct response copywriting principles and how they inform design hierarchy
  • Experience designing for additional platforms (TikTok, Google Display, YouTube)


Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Company Description


EMP is a media and technology company building audience-driven brands across digital media, content, and now SaaS products.

We started as a digital media group with a fan-first mindset and have grown into a company that blends content, distribution, and technology. Today, we are expanding beyond media into software products that support creators, brands, and audiences. That means design work here goes beyond social graphics and videos. It increasingly touches product thinking, UX/UI, and how software is presented to users.

We move fast, test often, and care about clean execution. Collaboration matters, but so does ownership. If you like building things that ship and actually get used, you will fit in well here.


You Are


An experienced graphic designer who can execute high-quality visual work across media and digital products. You are comfortable working in fast-moving environments, collaborating with editors, marketers, and product-minded teammates. You care about clarity, usability, and aesthetics, not just making things look cool.

You are also curious about software and product design, and you are interested in expanding your skill set into UX/UI and SaaS-oriented design work.


Role Description

This is a full-time, remote role for a Graphic Designer.

You will create visual assets across our media brands, including graphics, branding elements, and design systems for social, web, and video. You will also support our growing SaaS initiatives by contributing to UX/UI design, product mockups, and software framing using tools like Figma.

Your work will sit at the intersection of content, marketing, and product. You will help translate ideas into clean visuals, clear user flows, and consistent brand experiences across platforms.

Day-to-day responsibilities include concepting, designing, iterating based on feedback, and collaborating with media, marketing, and product stakeholders.


Responsibilities


  • Design graphics, branding assets, and visual systems for digital media platforms
  • Support video and social content with strong visual design
  • Contribute to UX/UI design for SaaS and internal software products
  • Create wireframes, mockups, and product flows using Figma
  • Maintain brand consistency across media, web, and product surfaces
  • Collaborate with marketing, content, and product teams
  • Iterate quickly and incorporate feedback without friction


Qualifications


  • Strong foundation in graphic design and visual communication
  • Experience with branding, logo design, and typography
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite
  • Working knowledge of Figma and interest in UX/UI or product design
  • Attention to detail and strong design judgment
  • Clear communication skills and ability to work independently in a remote setup
  • Experience in digital media, marketing, or tech is a plus
  • Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or equivalent experience
  • Fluent in English, written and spoken

title: Tax Analyst
description:
Tax Analyst - Ferragamo


About the Company

Ferragamo is a globally recognized Italian luxury fashion house, specialized in high-end footwear, leather goods, ready-to-wear, silk products, eyewear, watches, and accessories. With a strong heritage of craftsmanship and innovation, Ferragamo operates worldwide in the luxury retail industry.


We are currently seeking a Tax Analyst to join our team in a multinational retail environment.


Position Summary

The Tax Analyst will focus on Linx system operations, tax routines, and support for tax processes, including participation in tax reform implementation projects.


Key Responsibilities


Tax Operations in the Linx System

  • Creation of purchase and import orders;
  • Recording and posting of tax invoices;
  • Billing and issuance of tax invoices;
  • Issuance of electronic correction letters (CC-e);
  • Maintenance and update of product master data (tax classification, NCM, CST, CFOP, tax rates, etc.);
  • Maintenance and parameterization of tax rules in the system;
  • Maintenance of tax tables and rates.


Tax Routines and Compliance

  • Analysis and resolution of tax and operational discrepancies;
  • Support for internal and external audits;
  • Monitoring Brazilian tax legislation and assessing operational impacts;
  • Calculation of taxes on imported services;
  • Issuance of tax payment forms (MIT – DCTFWeb) and GNREs;
  • Support in direct and indirect tax calculations and ancillary obligations.


Projects & Process Improvement

  • Technical tax support in projects, including tax reform implementation;
  • Review and improvement of tax and operational processes;
  • Interface with accounting, logistics, operations, and IT teams;
  • Participation in system updates and automation initiatives.


Requirements

  • Fluency in Portuguese is required. English and/or Spanish is desirable for collaboration within a multinational environment.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Business Administration, or related fields;
  • Mandatory knowledge of Linx ERP system;
  • Previous experience in tax routines within retail companies;
  • Strong knowledge of Brazilian tax legislation, especially indirect taxes;
  • Experience in tax or system implementation projects.

title: English Teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: AI & Innovation Experience Designer
description:
AI & Innovation Experience Designer


About the Role

We are seeking an AI & Innovation Experience Designer to help define the next generation of intelligent commerce experiences. This role will focus on conceptualizing and designing new AI-powered capabilities and hyper-personalized shopping journeys for a large-scale digital marketplace platform.


You will own the AI Tools and Hyper-Personalization workstreams, exploring how generative AI, advanced data models, and intelligent systems can transform how customers discover products, interact with sellers, and navigate digital retail environments.


This role requires a designer who is comfortable operating in ambiguity and enjoys shaping 0-to-1 product concepts. You will translate emerging technologies into compelling user experiences through prototypes, concept designs, and future-state product visions.


What You’ll Do

  • Conceptualize new AI-powered commerce experiences across search, discovery, and personalized shopping journeys.
  • Design innovative features powered by generative AI and machine learning, such as contextual search, personalized product detail pages, AI-generated retail media, and intelligent seller tools.
  • Explore how data and personalization models can create dynamic, hyper-personalized user experiences throughout the shopping lifecycle.
  • Develop concept prototypes and design explorations that communicate future product possibilities and inspire product leadership.
  • Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and data teams to translate AI capabilities into meaningful user experiences.
  • Present forward-looking concepts and design narratives to stakeholders, helping shape the long-term product vision.
  • Operate within a fast-paced consulting environment with short delivery cycles and evolving requirements.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in product design or UX design, with exposure to emerging technologies or innovation-focused work
  • Experience designing AI-powered or data-driven product experiences
  • Strong conceptual thinking and ability to design future-state product concepts
  • Ability to communicate complex ideas through prototypes, visual concepts, and design storytelling
  • Understanding of personalization systems, recommendation engines, or conversational AI patterns
  • Comfort working in ambiguous, early-stage product environments
  • Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
  • Ability to work effectively in fast-paced consulting environments


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing GenAI-powered features, including conversational interfaces, AI search, content generation, or recommendation systems
  • Familiarity with retail media platforms, seller tools, or marketplace ecosystems
  • Experience designing for conversational commerce platforms such as messaging-based shopping experiences
  • Exposure to or interest in the Brazilian or Latin American technology ecosystem


This role is ideal for a designer who enjoys exploring the intersection of AI, commerce, and product innovation. If you’re excited about shaping intelligent, personalized digital experiences and pushing the boundaries of what modern e-commerce can become, we’d love to connect.

title: Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)
description:
Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)


Location: Brazil


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


Position Overview


As a Backend Team Lead , you will play a key role in leading the backend development team while contributing to the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions that support the company's mission and goals. You will guide and support the backend team while working closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities


  • Team Leadership:

Lead and support the backend engineering team, ensuring effective collaboration, task distribution, and delivery of high-quality software.

  • Platform Development:

Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel , ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.

  • Database Development:

Creating database schemas that represent and support business processes.

  • API Development and Integration:

Develop and maintain APIs for internal and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare systems and third-party services.

  • Security Compliance:

Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare industry standards, including HIPAA , by implementing and maintaining robust security measures and data protection protocols.


Additional Responsibilities


  • Mentor backend developers, providing guidance on best practices in backend development, code review, and team collaboration.
  • Support the team in resolving technical challenges and ensure consistent development standards across the team.
  • Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to continually innovate and enhance the platform.
  • Participate in the agile development process, contributing to sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software.
  • Collaborate with the design team to refine the platform's user interface and experience, implementing responsive and intuitive front-end functionalities using modern JavaScript frameworks.


Competencies / Requirements


  • Technical Expertise:

Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL . Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git .

  • Experience:

At least 6+ years of experience in backend development , with a proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web applications. Previous experience leading or mentoring developers is required. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is highly desirable.

  • Problem-Solving Skills:

Ability to tackle complex problems, think analytically, and develop innovative solutions.

  • Communication Skills:

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

  • Attention to Detail:

A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and efficient platform.


Benefits


  • Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Senior SRE Engineer (Temporary Contract)
description:
About You

This is a high‑impact, high‑expectation senior DevOps/SRE role supporting a Private Equity Group (PEG) platform. The team is new, the infrastructure is new, and the customer is extremely selective and private.


You must operate with strong autonomy , influence engineering decisions, challenge assumptions, and serve as a thought partner rather than an order‑taker. You will work directly with VP‑level stakeholders in a technical environment where reliability, deployment safety, and clarity in communication are essential.


This position requires someone who can own DevOps architecture end‑to‑end , enable safe and frequent deployments, and establish operational excellence from day zero.


Note: This position is offered under a contractor model for a period of 6 months .


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies

  • Proven ownership of production-grade CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions reusable workflows and GitOps automation with ArgoCD .
  • Expert-level Kubernetes and EKS operations , including node group management, Karpenter autoscaling, RBAC, PDBs, and topology constraints.
  • Production-scale Terraform expertise , including module design, S3 + DynamoDB remote state , and PR-driven workflows via Atlantis .
  • Strong reliability engineering experience , including SLO/SLI design, alerting strategies, dashboards, incident response, and post-incident reviews.
  • Hands-on experience operating HashiCorp Vault , including auth backends, PKI, dynamic secrets, and audit logging.
  • Experience implementing supply-chain security controls , including image scanning and signing, SBOM generation, and policy enforcement with OPA/Gatekeeper.
  • Strong experience with observability stacks , including Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, and Alertmanager.
  • Experience with service mesh technologies such as Istio , including traffic management, mTLS, AuthorizationPolicies, and circuit breaking.
  • Scripting ability using Python and Bash for automation and operational tooling.
  • Active use of AI-assisted engineering tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Cloud Code to accelerate IaC development, incident response, and runbook generation.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and confidently with VP-level stakeholders during operational incidents.
  • Advanced English proficiency, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain GitHub Actions reusable workflows across a multi-repository ecosystem.
  • Own GitOps deployments through ArgoCD , including promotion workflows, sync policies, drift detection, and automated rollback strategies.
  • Implement deployment safety mechanisms such as environment protections, concurrency rules, and verification gates .
  • Operate and upgrade EKS clusters , including Karpenter provisioning, node groups, and critical cluster add-ons.
  • Maintain Terraform-driven infrastructure and enforce PR-driven workflows through Atlantis.
  • Define and maintain SLOs, SLIs, alerting rules, and monitoring dashboards across platform services.
  • Lead incident response , coordinate recovery efforts, and execute structured post-incident reviews.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation and contribute to improving operational processes.
  • Operate and maintain HashiCorp Vault , including policies, authentication backends, and secret engines.
  • Implement supply-chain security controls , including Trivy scanning, Cosign signing, SBOM generation, and OPA/Gatekeeper enforcement.
  • Partner with Security Engineering on network policies, egress controls, and compliance standards .
  • Automate repetitive tasks and maintain proactive runbooks to reduce operational risk.
  • Use AI tools to improve infrastructure automation, documentation, and deployment safety validation.
  • Collaborate with product teams to strengthen SLOs and deployment safety practices .
  • Challenge technical assumptions and advocate for scalable, secure DevOps architectures .


Qualifications

  • Proven end-to-end ownership of production-grade Kubernetes/EKS environments including Karpenter and Atlantis-driven Terraform workflows.
  • Demonstrated expertise with ArgoCD GitOps patterns.
  • Hands-on experience with HashiCorp Vault, supply-chain security controls, and structured incident response including on-call rotations and post-incident reviews.
  • Active use of AI-assisted tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Cloud Code as part of daily engineering workflow.


Additional Information

About Us


We Are Engineered Different.


At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

title: Coordenador de produção
description:
Quem somos


A Granistone é referência global na produção de rochas ornamentais brasileiras, combinando tradição, inovação e sustentabilidade. Fundada em 1989, somos uma empresa cearense com presença internacional, que atua em toda a cadeia produtiva — da extração à entrega de materiais exclusivos para projetos de alto padrão. Nosso compromisso vai além da excelência: valorizamos a ética, a responsabilidade ambiental e relações duradouras. Aqui, você fará parte de um time apaixonado pelo que faz, com espaço para crescer, inovar e transformar.


Nossos Valores:

Temos valores cristãos, bons costumes e ética.

Agimos com verdade, honestidade e integridade;

Respeitamos o próximo;

Liberalismo econômico;

Atitude, Garra e Pro atividade;

Trabalhamos com união e confiabilidade


Vaga:

Coordenador de Produção

Local: Vieirópolis - PB

Modalidade PJ


Perfil:

Ensino superior concluído em Engenharia de Minas , Engenharia de Produção, Engenharia Mecânica, ou áreas afins;

Pós graduação nas áreas correlatas;

Experiência na função;

Vivência no segmento de Mineração é um diferencial;

Conhecimento em Gestão de Projetos;

Conhecimentos intermediários em Excel;

Conhecimento Avançado em Planejamento e Controle de Produção – PCP;

Conhecimento Intermediário em Gestão da Qualidade;

Conhecimento em Gestão Orçamentária;



Principais Atividades:

  • Planejar e coordenar as operações de extração de rochas, assegurando a eficiência e segurança dos processos;
  • Desenvolver planos de lavra e estudar a viabilidade econômica de jazidas de rochas ornamentais;
  • Analisar e interpretar dados geológicos para otimizar a extração de materiais;
  • Garantir que as operações de mineração estejam em conformidade com as regulamentações ambientais e de segurança;
  • Coordenar o processo de perfuração, desmonte e transporte de rochas;
  • Coordenar as atividades de escavação e transporte, garantindo a correta disposição dos materiais extraídos;
  • Avaliar as condições dos terrenos e determinar os melhores métodos de extração, levando em consideração fatores ambientais e técnicos;
  • Gerir os recursos necessários para as operações de mineração, incluindo mão de obra, equipamentos e insumos;
  • Colaborar com o planejamento estratégico da empresa, fornecendo dados sobre a capacidade de produção e custos;
  • Implementar e monitorar técnicas de otimização de produção e redução de custos operacionais;
  • Coordenar a manutenção de equipamentos de mineração e garantir sua operacionalidade contínua;
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos sobre as condições da mina e os resultados das operações;
  • Acompanhar o controle de qualidade do material extraído, verificando sua conformidade com as especificações;
  • Desenvolver e implementar práticas sustentáveis e de recuperação ambiental nas áreas de mineração;
  • Coordenar a aplicação de tecnologias inovadoras para aumentar a eficiência e segurança das operações;
  • Monitorar indicadores de desempenho das operações de lavra, propondo melhorias contínuas;
  • Coordenar os riscos operacionais relacionados à segurança do trabalho e ao meio ambiente;
  • Realizar auditorias periódicas nas operações de mineração para garantir o cumprimento de normas e procedimentos;
  • Manter atualizados todos os cadastros no ERP relativos ao processo produtivo: estruturas de produtos, roteiros de operações, mão-de-obra para produção dos itens e demais cadastros necessários, garantindo a confiabilidade de tais dados no sistema;
  • Compor juntamente com o superior imediato os planos de produção de acordo com demandas de equipamentos e os níveis de estoque, de forma a garantir disponibilidade do estoque mínimo estratégico de equipamentos e suas partes;
  • Coordenar os processos de produção através do monitoramento de indicadores, realização de reuniões periódicas com a equipe, informando as metas da empresa à equipe de trabalho, definindo ações, e /ou estratégias para o planejamento, execução e controle, visando otimização da produção e redução de falhas;
  • Acompanhar saldo de material no estoque e solicitações e pedidos de compras, obtendo prazos de entrega e disponibilidade de materiais, evitando descontinuidade na produção;
  • Monitorar planilhas de acompanhamento de produção, elaborar cronograma das atividades e organizar a produção de acordo com a demanda, mantendo o almoxarifado abastecido;
  • Promover melhorias no processo de produção, trabalhando em conformidade com as normas e procedimentos técnicos e de qualidade, segurança, higiene, saúde e preservação ambiental;
  • Inspecionar as condições de máquinas e equipamentos e requisitar a manutenção quando necessário, elaborando plano de manutenção preventiva/corretiva;
  • Elaborar e coordenar o desmembramento do Plano de Produção da Mina, acompanhando sua execução e realizando as adequações necessárias;
  • Controlar custos de produção, identificando e implantando oportunidades de redução;
  • Executar demais atividades correlatas ao cargo, segundo necessidades da área e direcionamento do gestor.

title: Closer

Requisitos para a vaga:

  • Experiência prévia com vendas consultivas B2B, preferencialmente em serviços.
  • Habilidade em construção de relacionamento com clientes corporativos.
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita.
  • Organização e gestão de funil de vendas.

  • Espanhol ou inglês avançado.


O que oferecemos:

  • Plano de saúde e odontológico.

title: Bilingual Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:

We are looking for a strategic, results-driven Talent Acquisition Specialist with strong experience recruiting for the US market within LATAM nearshore models.

• Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times;

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer
description:
Na Workana, estamos em busca de um/a Engenheiro/a Fullstack Sênior para integrar o time de um dos nossos clientes e assumir um papel estratégico no desenvolvimento de ferramentas internas e sistemas de backoffice.


Sobre o cliente:

Trata-se de uma plataforma que gerencia fluxos logísticos altamente complexos, operando em múltiplas regiões e ambientes de alto volume. Atuando sob um modelo competitivo de ROWE – Results-Only Work Environment, no qual buscamos pessoas que desafiem o pensamento tradicional, proponham novas ideias e ajudem a redefinir como as operações modernas são construídas e escaladas.


Sobre o Projeto:

O/a profissional terá um papel estratégico nas decisões técnicas, na definição de arquiteturas robustas e na entrega de funcionalidades que impulsionam nossas operações em dezenas de cidades. A plataforma evoluiu para lidar com fluxos logísticos altamente complexos, e o time de engenharia encara desafios empolgantes todos os dias. Buscamos alguém que vá além da excelência técnica: que escreva código de alto nível, lidere iniciativas de impacto, mentore colegas e contribua ativamente para moldar o futuro dos nossos sistemas.


Responsabilidades Principais:

  • Liderar a implementação de módulos frontend robustos e micro-frontends para nossa plataforma interna.
  • Projetar e manter a arquitetura e lógica backend utilizando Node.js, Express e MySQL.
  • Participar de discussões de design de sistemas e tomadas de decisão técnicas.
  • Propor e implementar melhorias em toda a stack com foco em performance e escalabilidade.
  • Garantir a qualidade do código seguindo boas práticas, revisões e testes automatizados.
  • Colaborar de perto com os times de Produto, Design e Operações para entender e resolver problemas reais de usuários.
  • Oferecer orientação técnica e mentoria para outros/as engenheiros/as.


Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação ou experiência equivalente.
  • Mínimo 5 anos de experiência profissional como desenvolvedor/a fullstack.
  • Proficiência em Node.js e Express , incluindo design assíncrono e APIs REST .
  • Forte domínio em React.js (Context API, hooks, componentes customizados, gerenciamento de estado).
  • Experiência sólida com MySQL . Elasticsearch é um diferencial.
  • Experiência integrando bibliotecas de mapas (Google Maps, Mapbox) .
  • Confortável trabalhando com Firebase para armazenamento.
  • Conhecimento em AWS (S3, Lambda) .
  • Capacidade de arquitetar sistemas escaláveis , seguros e de fácil manutenção.
  • Fluência em escrever código limpo, testável e bem documentado.
  • Boa comunicação, espírito de equipe e atitude proativa.
  • Disponibilidade para participar de rodízio de plantão técnico (on-call rotation) , cobrindo turnos noturnos e períodos de alta demanda.
  • Flexibilidade para atuar em horas extras remuneradas, em caso de incidentes técnicos.


Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento e uso de Typescript.
  • Experiência com logística ou plataformas operacionais complexas.
  • Inglês fluente (falado e escrito).


Condições Contratuais e Benefícios:

  • Modelo de trabalho: 100% Remoto.
  • Jornada: Tempo integral (8 horas por dia).
  • Remuneração: Entre R$ 11.000,00 e R$ 14.000,00 mensais.
  • Contratação: PJ via cooperativa, diretamente com o cliente.
  • Estabilidade: Possibilidade de parceria de longo prazo.
  • Notebook da empresa.
  • Dia de folga remunerada no aniversário.
  • 5 dias de Paid Time Off por ano, além do período de férias.
  • Ambiente multicultural, com oportunidades de aprendizado junto a equipes de diversos países da região.


Processo de Seleção:

  • Vídeo screening rápido na plataforma Hireflix;
  • Teste técnico prático na plataforma Adaface (simulando desafios reais);
  • Breve call de alinhamento com recruiter da Workana;
  • Entrevista Técnica Cultural + Live Coding com cliente.


Se você está interessado/a nessa posição e acha que é a pessoa certa, aguardamos sua inscrição. Se você for selecionado/a para continuar, alguém da equipe Workana Talent entrará em contato com você!

title: Motorista Veículo Semi Pesado
description:
VAGA: MOTORISTA VEÍCULO SEMI-PESADO


Local: Americana/SP


Muito mais do que apenas pisar no acelerador. Acreditamos que o movimento transforma e que a experiência de conduzir um veículo é também sobre confiar nos produtos que cuidam do seu carro enquanto você se concentra em seu caminho.


A marca Panther está presente em 24 estados do Brasil, com ampla e eficiente rede de distribuição dos nossos produtos. Contamos com mais de 150 produtos em nosso portfólio e grande capacidade de produção, nos mais altos padrões de qualidade, versatilidade e tecnologia.


A Energy Petro está em expansão e buscamos Motorista de Veículos Semi-Pesados  para se juntar ao nosso time.


Responsabilidades


Dentre as suas principais responsabilidades, você irá encontrar:


  • Realizar o transporte de produtos e mercadorias da empresa, garantindo a entrega dentro dos prazos estabelecidos;
  • Conduzir veículos semi-pesados com segurança, observando a legislação de trânsito e as normas internas da empresa;
  • Efetuar o carregamento, descarregamento e conferência das cargas transportadas, assegurando a integridade dos produtos;
  • Realizar inspeções básicas no veículo antes, durante e após as viagens, verificando condições de funcionamento e segurança;
  • Zelar pela conservação, limpeza e bom uso do veículo sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Preencher corretamente os registros, controles de viagem, checklists e demais documentos relacionados à operação;
  • Apoiar a organização e movimentação de cargas quando necessário;
  • Utilizar os equipamentos adequados, garantindo a sua segurança e a de colegas de trabalho;
  • Observar rigorosamente todas as normas de segurança e fazer uso correto dos equipamentos de proteção individual.


Qualificações


  • CNH ativa, categoria C ou D ;
  • Experiência prévia como Motorista de Veículos Semi-Pesados ;
  • Conhecimento básico em conferência de cargas e documentação de transporte;
  • Disponibilidade para atuação conforme necessidade da operação;
  • Desejável experiência com rotas regionais e transporte de produtos industriais.


A remuneração será compatível com o mercado, com a experiência e qualificação.


Benefícios


  • Contratação CLT: 44 horas semanais com 1h de intervalo diário;
  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico;
  • Vale Refeição e/ou Vale Alimentação - Flash;
  • Oportunidades de Desenvolvimento e Crescimento junto com a Energy.


Quer fazer parte de um dos times que mais cresce no Brasil? Mande seu CV pra nós.

title: Shopify E-Commerce Specialist - Remote - USD compensation
description:
About Staff4Half & Our Client

Staff4Half specializes in providing high-quality virtual specialists to help businesses supercharge their productivity. We offer tailored solutions across various domains, empowering companies to achieve their goals efficiently and effectively through customized support.

We are currently partnering with a fast-growing, Direct-to-Consumer (D2C) e-commerce brand to find a dedicated E-Commerce Specialist. In this role, you will work directly with our client's team to drive tangible results, manage their digital storefront, and maximize sales opportunities.


Key Responsibilities
  • Shopify & Product Management: Execute directions from the E-commerce Manager to update pricing, add new products, and maintain the homepage, collections, and product pages. Build and maintain landing pages, optimize listings for SEO and sales, and manage apps that enhance the customer experience.
  • Merchandising & Website Optimization: Follow merchandising strategies to highlight key products and promotions. Build campaign-specific landing pages, troubleshoot site issues, and strategically utilize apps to boost conversion rates.
  • Email & SMS Marketing (Klaviyo): Execute email and SMS campaigns and flows. Segment audiences, monitor performance metrics, and rigorously test formatting, deliverability, and links.
  • SEO & Site Performance: Support ongoing SEO initiatives, including keyword implementation, on-page optimization, content updates, and basic technical SEO. Monitor site performance using analytics tools and recommend improvements to drive organic traffic.
  • General Support & Reporting: Execute tasks according to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), clearly communicate progress or roadblocks, identify opportunities to increase sales, and collaborate closely with the design and customer service teams.
  • Ad Hoc Requests: Handle additional E-commerce and D2C operational tasks as directed to support the overall growth of the brand.
Qualifications

Core Requirements:

  • Experience: 1+ years of proven experience working in a fast-paced Shopify environment.
  • Technical Platforms: Hands-on experience with Shopify (adding products, managing collections, landing pages, and apps) and Klaviyo or similar platforms (email/SMS campaigns, segmentation, flows, and A/B testing).
  • Analytical Skills: Strong ability to assess data, monitor performance, and identify concrete growth opportunities.
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication, alongside great customer service skills to ensure positive interactions with stakeholders.
  • Mindset: Proactive problem-solver with a positive, can-do attitude, strong initiative, and excellent follow-through. Ability to follow strategic direction and execute tasks accurately.

Bonus Points (Nice-to-Have):

  • Familiarity with analytics platforms like GA4, Google Search Console, Commission Junction, and Google Analytics.
  • Understanding of e-commerce best practices, including SEO and site optimization.
  • Experience with specific Shopify apps like Timesact Pre-order, Conjured Memberships, heat map tools, and quiz apps (we are happy to train the right person on these!).
What We Offer
  • Compensation: Competitive salary rate in USD (Semi-Senior level).
  • Work Setup: 100% Fully Remote Contractor role.
  • Time Off: 12 days of paid time off (PTO) plus holidays.
  • Growth: Yearly salary revisions based on performance.

description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu porcesso de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.


Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho:

-Será responsável por auxiliar na implementação e manutenção das políticas de segurança da informação, apoiar na gestão de riscos cibernéticos e garantir que a empresa esteja alinhada às normas e regulamentações de segurança.

-Atuará no suporte às auditorias, conformidade regulatória e implementação de controles internos de segurança.

- Auxiliar na implementação e monitoramento das políticas e normas de segurança da informação.

title: Clinical Research Coordinator
description:
Company Overview

Bioscience Consulting, Inc. is a boutique, compliance‑focused CRO specializing in medical device development across Latin America. Our cross‑cultural team supports early‑stage research with tailored regulatory and clinical services. We deliver high‑quality, ethics‑driven solutions to help innovators bring safe and effective technologies to market.

Position: Clinical Research Coordinator (Junior / Early‑Career)

Location: Florianopolis, Santa Catarina, Brasil — Hybrid (onsite + remote)

Employment: Part‑time , contract

Role Summary: We are hiring a proactive Clinical Research Coordinator to support medical device clinical studies in Florianopolis. Reporting to the Clinical Project Lead, you will coordinate daily trial activities, ensure protocol and GCP compliance, manage participant interactions, and maintain accurate study documentation in both English and Portuguese

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate and support study startup, site initiation, and routine site activities.
  • Screen, enroll, and consent participants according to protocol and local regulations.
  • Collect and enter clinical data in EDC systems; maintain source documents.
  • Help to prepare and submit safety reports (SAEs/ADRs) and support regulatory filings.
  • Maintain Trial Master File and site regulatory binders; ensure document/version control.
  • Facilitate communication between sponsors, sites, monitors, and vendors.
  • Support monitoring visits, audits, and corrective actions.
  • Track study timelines, enrollment metrics, and deliverables; proactively escalate risks.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a scientific, medical, or health‑related field.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (written and spoken).
  • Working knowledge of Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and clinical trial processes.
  • Some hands‑on experience in clinical research coordination or related roles.
  • Experience with clinical data capture / EDC or willingness to learn quickly.
  • Experience managing patient interactions and preparing safety reports.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to work collaboratively.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Being proactive is key. Must be able to demonstrate a high degree of autonomy
  • Prior experience with medical device studies is a plus.
  • Familiarity with Clinical Trials and their related procedures
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities to collaborate with diverse teams

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work on early‑stage medical device projects.
  • Hybrid work model with flexible schedule and supportive, cross‑cultural team.
  • Competitive compensation (please include desired salary in application ).
  • Contractual benefits per Brazilian labor regulations.

How to Apply : Submit your CV and a short cover letter outlining your relevant experience and desired compensation.
